assembly_interface_policy.source_interface_face_roles: Mixed source-interface patches are evaluated against the frozen original assembly: retain open microseams, hole-mouth annuli and 0.15mm side strips; bury only actual material overlap/coincident shared subdomains. They are original source boundaries, not artificial closure faces.

cross_part_adjacency.relation: Unchanged piecewise source overlap/coincidence and open microseams. No inflation or intentional new overlap.
Shared y=-70mm source interface; retain annuli and narrow side strips.

assembly_interface_policy.artificial_closure_rule: Every generated closure patch is paired with an actual neighboring convex entity inside the same source-part union; none is an intended exterior contact surface.
assembly_interface_policy.external_ownership: Disjoint source-part boundary fragments have unique ownership within each source part. Shared assembly interfaces are internal only over their actual common subdomains. Original material overlap is not a second exposed workface.

replacement.collision_000: Fully replace each gripper_link{1,2}_collision_000 active geom by contact_layer + backing entities; never retain the old hull underneath.
replacement.collision_001: Fully replace each gripper_link{1,2}_collision_001 active geom by mount_block entities; never retain the old hull underneath.
replacement.old_files: Retain unchanged as historical baseline; do not instantiate them alongside the future partition.

future_geometry_emission.inertial_policy: Preserve explicit existing robot inertials; do not infer mass from new collision geometry.
future_geometry_emission.physical_parameters: Inherit frozen control/contact configuration unchanged; this document does not authorize active MJCF generation.

construction.method: Exact rational source-triangle xy projection overlay; upper/lower affine height cells; deterministic largest-volume-first equal-volume certified convex merge within functional family
construction.convex_merge_rule: Every scipy-proposed hull facet must exactly support all input rational vertices; hull must be closed; exact rational hull volume must equal sum of disjoint source cell volumes
construction.topology_normalization_rule: For source part 504..659 only, choose existing lexicographically smallest literal vertex within 1e-16m; do not average or project. Source-equivalent endpoint normalization only, not nm facet simplification.

verification.source_boundary_uniqueness_basis: Exact per-source projected patch areas equal the source triangle area, and all positive-volume base-cell intersections are checked independently; original source triangle plane/outward orientation required for each patch.

mount_root.frame: Source local xyz in m; y increases tipward, root y=-0.0765m; inward gripper gap is -z.

nonsupporting_numerical_boundary_slivers.interpretation: Boundary clipping tolerance includes a narrow nonsupporting neighbor-face sliver. Not a convex-hull facet and not counted as an entity source patch. The full source face is independently assigned to its true supporting owner(s). Geometry is not changed by this classification.

mount_root.partition_rule: Positive-y source graph triangles projected to xz; source slot x=+-3.7mm defines left/right ears and bridge. Close to y=-76.5mm for ears, y=-73mm for bridge, except bore source triangle451. Deterministic convex-volume-preserving merges within each semantic zone.
mount_root.numerical_tolerance_note: Floating-point geometric algorithm tolerances, not new physical acceptance criteria or CI gates. The 0.5nm overlap-radius reporting limit is a numerical resolution declaration, not a proof of mathematical strict zero. Actual maximum LP common interior radius and actual source/closure area residuals are reported alongside it. Cell width/inradius are descriptive and do not impose a new thickness requirement.
mount_root.minimum_claim: Greedy locally merge-maximal within frozen seed cells and semantic zones. No global minimum claim; all source tessellation lip triangles retained.
mount_root.internal_closure_ownership: Every positive-area internal closure patch must be covered by neighboring mount_root entities. No internal closure is declared an intended external contact surface.
mount_root.cross_part_note: All mount_root cells come only from source faces0..503. No backing/thin-layer source face is claimed here; root interfaces must be resolved by the global partition owner.

verification.convexity: Every entity is the ConvexHull of the explicit vertices; hull facets supplied outward.
verification.overlap: Construction partitions exact z material intervals; pair merges accepted only when every new hull facet is covered by the old pair. No designed overlap.

verification.scope: Offline source partition and geometry audit only. No MuJoCo import, compilation, collision query, integration, grasp, benchmark or parameter modification.

global_assembly_boundary_verification.coordinate_policy: Unchanged original source-local coordinates; arithmetic scaled to mm only. No inflation, boundary relocation, hole closure, material deletion or collision filtering.
global_assembly_boundary_verification.local_partition_verification_note: This analysis never upgrades or overrides any source-part local verification status. Inputs with unresolved source/closure checks produce diagnostic interface results only.
global_assembly_boundary_verification.classification_scope: Source-part union boundary of the inputs currently loaded. Exterior classifications are provisional while pending_inputs is nonempty.
global_assembly_boundary_verification.coincident_exterior_note: Any positive-area same-normal exterior duplication is explicitly flagged as a design issue. No canonical-owner metadata is substituted for physical deduplication; original cells remain unchanged and no filters are added.

numeric_resolution.interpretation: Computational-geometry tolerances, not new physical acceptance gates. Positive overlap below reporting resolution is not asserted mathematically zero.

global_assembly_boundary_verification.geometry_emission_rule: Original entity vertices/faces remain unchanged and all bodies keep ordinary external collision. Exterior/interface subpolygons are ownership evidence, never a request to emit open-faced collision solids.
global_assembly_boundary_verification.provenance_rule: Input hashes are captured from the exact bytes read at load time; a concurrent later edit is reported and cannot silently change the evidence binding.

geometry_conditioning.method: Widths in facet-normal directions from frozen vertices. Geometry conditioning only; no engine or new acceptance threshold.
geometry_conditioning.interpretation: Literal source-facet micro-tilts create sub-nanometre cells. This is disclosed, not silently coarsened. Partition freeze is a geometry-design freeze, not certification of engine compilation, numerical conditioning, runtime cost or physical plausibility of source-scale detail.

boundary_schema.internal_closure_patches: New partition closure polygons with actual neighbor coverage.
boundary_schema.support_plane_id: Index into the same entity halfspaces_m, unit [nx,ny,nz,d_m], n dot p + d_m <= 0.
